item.title: How to Restore a Single WordPress Page from a WP Engine Backup
item.description:
WordPress has no native “restore single page from backup” feature. WP Engine’s backup system saves your entire site, database and files, as one package. To restore one page, you must go into the raw database dump and extract it yourself.

This post documents exactly how to do this: extract a single page from a WP Engine full-site database backup and restore it to WordPress via the REST API, section by section, without touching anything else on the site.

item.title: How to Restore a Single WordPress Page from a WP Engine Backup (Without Restoring the Whole Site)
I Restored a Single WordPress Page from a WP Engine Backup Using Claude and MCP — Here's Exactly How
item.description:
By Pranoti Kshirsagar · AI Integration & Automation Specialist

A WordPress page broke. I had a WP Engine backup from two days before. The standard fix — restore the whole site — would have wiped 48 hours of content I couldn’t get back.

So I didn’t do that.

The problem with full-site restores

WP Engine’s backup system is excellent. But it restores everything or nothing. There is no “restore this one page” button. If you trigger a restore, your database reverts to the snapshot state — which means anything created or updated after that point is gone.

item.title: How to Connect Your Self-Hosted WordPress Site to Claude Desktop
How to Connect Your Self-Hosted WordPress Site to Claude Desktop via MCP
item.description:
You can create, edit, and manage your WordPress posts without opening your browser. Claude Desktop and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) let you connect your self-hosted WordPress site directly to Claude. You can then manage your entire content workflow through natural language conversation.

What the integration enables

  • “Show me all draft posts”
  • “Create a new draft about European AI regulation”
  • “Change the title of post 1234 to…”
  • “Analyze the SEO of my latest published post”
  • “Add the tag ‘Horizon Europe’ to all posts from 2025”
  • “List all images uploaded this month”

The MCP server provides tools for read, write, bulk operations, SEO analysis, and media management. You can use all tools directly from a Claude conversation. You do not need to configure plugins on your WordPress site. You do not need to learn a third-party dashboard.
